blocks.text: Superfluidity fluids ki woh khoobi hai jis mein un ki viscosity zero hoti hai, yani un mein bilkul ragar (friction) nahi hoti. Jis maadde mein yeh khoobi ho use superfluid kehte hain. Superfluid behte hue apni kinetic energy nahi khota. Laboratory mein kuch maadde cryogenic temperature (intehai thanda, absolute zero se thora sa oopar) par superfluid ban jate hain.
Superfluids bohat hi tang jagahon mein se bhi bina kisi rukawat ke guzar jate hain. Yeh gravity ke khilaf oopar ki taraf bhi beh sakte hain (Fig. 5.24, kitab ki tasveer).

Superfluids aisa anokha rawayya dikhate hain jo aam fluids aur gases mein nahi hota. Maslan kitab ke mutabiq helium-3 bartan ki deewaron par charh kar bahar nikal sakta hai; ise film flow kehte hain. Yeh bartan ki deewaron mein se bhi guzar sakta hai. Hilane par superfluids mein bhanwar (vortices) bante hain jo khatam nahi hote, jab ke aam fluids kuch der baad ruk jate hain. Superfluid ka bartan ghumayein to andar ka liquid ruka rehta hai, coffee ke cup ki tarah saath nahi ghoomta. Superfluid mein normal aur superfluid dono hisse mile hote hain; temperature jitna kam, superfluid hissa utna zyada. Kuch superfluids garmi bohat achhi guzarte hain (high thermal conductivity). Yaad rahe ke superfluidity aur superconductivity alag cheezein hain; helium-3 aur helium-4 dono superfluid hain magar bijli nahi guzarte.

Helium-4 superfluidity ki sab se zyada parhi gayi misal hai. Yeh apne boiling point −452°F (−269°C ya 4 K) se chand degree neeche liquid se superfluid ban jata hai. Superfluid helium-4 aam saaf liquid jaisa dikhta hai magar us mein viscosity nahi hoti; is liye ek dafa behna shuru kare to har rukawat ke paas se behta chala jata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Parachute ka bara area hawa ki rukawat (drag) barha deta hai, jo gravity ki force ka muqabla karti hai. Is se girne wale shakhs ki speed kam ho jati hai aur woh mehfooz utar jata hai (5.13 aur 5.14 ka drag aur terminal velocity).

Abhi superfluids ke amli istemal kam hain. Superfluid helium-4 taqatwar (high-field) magnets ko thanda karne (coolant) ke kaam aata hai. Helium-3 aur helium-4 dono jadeed particle detectors mein istemal hote hain. Superfluidity par research se superconductivity ko samajhne mein bhi madad milti hai.

Liquid helium garmi bohat achhi guzarta hai, is liye cryogenic (intehai thande) kaamon mein istemal hota hai: superconducting magnets ko thanda karna, scientific research aur medical istemal. Sanat (industry) mein yeh leak testing (rasao dhoondne) aur electronic aur optical cheezein banane mein bhi kaam aata hai.

blocks.prompt: Superfluid ki bunyadi khoobi kya hai, aur is ka mutaala kyun ahem hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki viscosity zero hoti hai (ragar nahi). Superfluids sirf absolute zero ke qareeb bante hain aur aise anokhe kaam karte hain jo aam fluids nahi karte, jaise na rukne wale bhanwar aur deewaron par charhna (film flow). Kitab ke mutabiq in par research superconductivity ko samajhne mein madad deti hai, aur liquid helium thande (cryogenic) kaamon, jaise superconducting magnets ko thanda karne, mein istemal hota hai.

items: Superfluid: viscosity zero, ragar nahi, K.E. nahi khota; absolute zero ke qareeb banta hai.
Tang jagahon se behta, deewaron par charhta (film flow), na rukne wale bhanwar, ghoomte bartan mein ruka rehta; superconductor nahi.
Misalein: helium-4 (taqreeban 4 K ke qareeb), helium-3, kuch Bose-Einstein condensates, Rb-85, Li-6, Na, shayad neutron stars. Istemal: magnet coolant, particle detectors, cryogenics, leak testing.
